scene: You zip across rooftops and land at a multi-transit sky platform.
picture: Flat side-view along a polished concrete sky platform. Far left, a magenta light-rail pod sits open. Left of centre, the silver-haired boy in mint hoodie adjusts his dance bag. Centre, an illuminated yellow moving walkway extends forward. Right, a turquoise hover ferry bobs beside a metal pier. Overhead cables glitter with city lights.
shown: a sleek magenta light-rail pod waiting open on the left track
a glowing yellow moving walkway running toward an archway at centre
